title: site alert dont stack dont panic
name: Site alert: don't stack, don't panic — USWDS
rule: One full-width site alert near the top. Do not stack. Multiple messages = a list of links inside a single site alert. Positioning already gives weight; do not use heavy red/orange panic colour. Dual-cite GOV.UK notification banner and System status: sitewide static, never form validation, never stacked.
pass_when: At most one sitewide static site alert; extra messages are links inside it; not used for form/task validation; colour is not panic-red/orange as the only weight.
fail_when: Stacked site alerts; site alert used as field/page form validation; or panic colour as the only signal.
overview: Use one full-width site alert near the top; extra messages become links inside it, without panic colour.
apply_when: Publishing sitewide static status that must stay visible across pages.
not_when: Form or task validation, or stacked separate site alerts.
agent_hint: Ship one site alert; nest extra messages as links; avoid panic-red as the only weight.
description: USWDS allows one full-width site alert near the top. Do not stack alerts; multiple messages become a list of links inside a single site alert. Positioning already gives weight—do not rely on heavy red or orange panic colour. Dual-cite GOV.UK notification banner and system-status guidance: sitewide static, never form validation, never stacked. Stacked alerts, validation misuse, or panic colour as the only signal fail.
do_not_claim: Page alert type-word (`uswds.alert-first-word-is-type`); live system-status toasts.
